bug_semantics: When user tracking is enabled, phpMyFAQ writes every request's raw QUERY_STRING and Referer verbatim into the publicly readable tracking file content/core/data/trackingDDMMYYYY (Tracking.php writes with file_put_contents, no auth, served under web root). The 2026 signed-token password reset flow (resetpw.php) places the signed reset token directly in the URL query (?u=&exp=&sig=) and calls userTracking('reset_password', 0), so the unguessable reset token is persisted to the tracking log. An unauthenticated attacker who can read the tracking file extracts valid tokens and replays them against the reset endpoint to take over arbitrary user accounts (CWE-532 Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File, chained to account takeover).
flaw_origin: Commit 41d7436f5bb7d4b7954a74d1c8f1f36bd157ffcf ("fix: replace plaintext password reset with signed token flow", 2026-05-08, author+committer Thorsten Rinne) created phpmyfaq/resetpw.php, which reads the signed token from the request query and immediately calls `$faqSession->userTracking('reset_password', 0)` — routing a secret-bearing URL into a logger that verbatim-persists QUERY_STRING (UserSession.php line ~212, pre-existing behavior) into the world-readable tracking file. The advisory's named sink — reset tokens landing in the public tracking file — is created by this commit: without resetpw.php logging token-bearing URLs, no token ever reaches the tracking log. The verbatim QUERY_STRING logging and the tracking-file path (content/core/data/tracking+date) predate the commit (refactor 5e7a38c29c7a moved the class; UserSession already logged QUERY_STRING), so they are recorded as the enabling wave, not the flaw.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer Thorsten Rinne with a plain human message; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object (grep NONE-41D7 sentinel).

Parent e3927a31b2 has no resetpw.php.", 'Enabling wave (decomposed): 5e7a38c29c7a (2024-10-29, "refactor: moved tracking stuff into own class", #3202) established the Tracking class writing to content/core/data/trackingDDMMYYYY; the verbatim QUERY_STRING logging predates the BIC (present in UserSession at parent e3927a31b2) — recorded as the wave making the log world-readable and verbatim.', 'Fix commits (2026-08-03, Thorsten Rinne): b1d405e26796 "fix: prevented leak of password reset tokens via user tracking log" (in tag 4.1.7) adds redaction of reset tokens in Tracking.php/UserSession.php via a new Utils helper plus nginx/.htaccess/web.config blocks on the tracking files; 9d2bfc0ef95b "fix: prevent password reset token leak via public user tracking logs" adds a dedicated TrackingDataRedactor (redactQueryString/redactUrl) wired into Tracking.php and UserSession.php. The fix redacting exactly the token from logged query strings proves token-into-log is the defect.', "Version boundary: b1d405e26796 is an ancestor of tag 4.1.7, matching the advisory's fixed version 4.1.7; BIC 41d7436f5bb7 first tagged 4.1-nightly-2026-05-11.", "AI-marker screening: `git log --format='%an <%ae>%n%cn <%ce>%n%B' -1` on 41d7436f5bb7 and 9d2bfc0ef95b — Thorsten Rinne only; grep for claude/copilot/anthropic/openai/generated/co-authored/cursor/junie finds nothing (NONE sentinels).", "ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29 against clone history: git show e3927a31:phpmyfaq/resetpw.php fails with 'path does not exist in e3927a31'; the BIC 41d7436f creates resetpw.php anew with $faqSession->userTracking('reset_password', 0) after the signed token arrives in the query string, so the token-into-tracking-log flow is absent at the parent. -> introducer_parent_absent=true."] direct_fix_sha aligned to the landed fix b1d405e267964f822b6bf228ef69e77f84c4240e (reconciliation 2026-08-29): the previously named commit 9d2bfc0ef95b7ce4494d8ea098ea6c22ea5d8564 is a sibling branch/backport commit, not an ancestor of the landed fix (merge-base verified).
reasoning: Vulnerability first: the advisory names reset tokens landing in the public tracking file; the code path shows resetpw.php feeding a sig-bearing URL into userTracking, which persists QUERY_STRING verbatim into content/core/data/trackingDDMMYYYY, and the fix adds exactly the token redaction plus web-server denial for the tracking directory — proving the token-to-log flow is the defect. BIC choice: 41d7436f5bb7 created the advisory's named sink (the signed-token flow that routes secret-bearing URLs into the public log); the verbatim logging and world-readable file are pre-existing enabling conditions recorded in decomposed_shas (5e7a38c29c7a wave). Squash check: the flaw spans the new reset flow over the pre-existing verbatim tracking pipeline, so squash_decomposed=true. AI decision: BIC-only attribution — the BIC object carries only the human identity Thorsten Rinne with no AI marker, so NOT_AI.
